# GiftSend

Send digital gift cards and prepaid rewards through Muse. Pick the recipient, amount, brand, and a short message — Muse drafts the reward, you review it, then pay face value plus a $2.99 service fee. Delivered by email, text, or link via Tremendous. Gift cards, Visa/Mastercard prepaid, and charity only. Created by Telep IO; fulfillment and billing at muse.telep.io.
